summary: Toray Research Center specializes in advanced analytical techniques and material property analysis for the semiconductor industry. They offer technical support for cause analysis and problem-solving in R&D and production technology, with a range of high-performance equipment including SIMS, mass spectrometers, and atomic force microscopes.
